faq.label: DOGO HELP CENTER
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about shopping with DOGO.
faq.orderQuestion: How can I place an order?
faq.orderAnswer: Choose the product and size you want and follow the steps to complete your order.
faq.deliveryAnswer: The standard delivery time is 1 to 3 business days after order confirmation. Orders within Bulgaria are delivered by Econt or Speedy to your address or to a convenient courier office.
faq.returnQuestion: Can I return or exchange a product?
faq.returnAnswer: Yes. You can return a product within 14 calendar days from the date of delivery. A size or model can be exchanged within 14 days of receiving the order, provided that the product meets the conditions for being returned in its original condition.
faq.paymentAnswer: Information about the available payment methods will be added soon.
faq.sizeQuestion: How do I choose the correct size?
faq.sizeAnswer: Measure your foot from the heel to the longest toe. For standard models, it is recommended to add approximately 1 cm to the measured length. Please note that sizing may vary depending on the specific model.

about.label: DOGO BULGARIA
about.title: Welcome to the world of DOGO Bulgaria!
about.intro: We believe that fashion is more than just clothing – it is a canvas for self-expression, a story you tell the world, and a choice made in harmony with nature.
about.storyTitle: How It All Began: The World's First
about.storyOne: As the official representative of DOGO in Bulgaria, our mission is to bring this colorful revolution to our streets and offer Bulgarian art lovers inspiring shoes and accessories.
about.storyTwo: Founded in 2006 in beautiful Izmir, Turkey, DOGO became a global pioneer as the first company to create unique and durable digital prints on eco-leather shoes. It all began with one bold idea: to transform an ordinary shoe into a moving work of art.
about.veganTitle: 100% Vegan and Caring for the Planet
about.veganIntro: At DOGO Bulgaria, ethical fashion is a cause we believe in. We do not use materials of animal origin.
about.veganProducts: 100% Vegan: All our products are certified vegan.
about.sustainability: Sustainability: We use high-quality eco-leather, certified cotton linings, and recyclable materials.
about.safeColors: Safe Colors: Our unique prints are created using environmentally friendly, solvent-free inks that are safe for both people and nature.
about.styleText: DOGO products are created for people who are not afraid to stand out. Every design carries an emotion – from classic literary themes and retro illustrations to modern urban graphics and playful animal prints. When you wear DOGO, you are not simply wearing shoes – you are expressing your individuality, sense of humor, and love of art.
about.whyTitle: Why Shop from the Official Bulgarian Website?
about.originalProducts: 100% original products directly from the DOGO factory.
about.collections: Exclusive access to the latest limited collections.
about.fastDelivery: Fast delivery throughout Bulgaria with an inspection and try-on option.
about.customerService: Professional customer service in Bulgarian, ready to assist you with any questions or size exchanges.
about.closing: Thank you for being part of our colorful family and choosing to step forward with kindness and style!

delivery.label: DOGO BULGARIA
delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.intro: As the official representative of DOGO in Bulgaria, our main goal is to provide you with a pleasant, secure and hassle-free shopping experience.
delivery.courierText: All shipments within Bulgaria are delivered by Econt / Speedy – to your address or to a convenient courier office.
delivery.timeText: Orders are processed quickly, with a standard delivery time of 1 to 3 business days after confirmation.
delivery.testText: Every shipment is sent with an inspection and try-on before payment option. Please use this option and try on the shoes in a clean area in front of the courier to make sure the size is right for you.

return.label: DOGO BULGARIA
return.title: Exchanges & Returns
return.intro: We know that choosing shoes online can sometimes be difficult, so we offer flexible and convenient exchange and return conditions.
return.exchangeText: If, after trying the shoes at home, you find that you need a different size or would like to exchange them for another model, you can do so within 14 days of receiving your order.
return.conditionProduct: The product must be in its original condition – it must not have been worn outdoors, washed, ironed or cleaned.
return.conditionBox: The shoes must be returned in their original undamaged DOGO box. Please protect the box with additional packaging or a bag when sending it by courier.
return.conditionLabels: All accompanying labels and accessories must remain attached to the product.
return.exchangeShipping: Courier costs for transporting the new size or model are covered by the customer.
return.returnText: Under Bulgarian law, you have the right to withdraw from your purchase and return the product within 14 calendar days from the date of delivery without providing a reason.
return.returnCondition: Make sure the shoes meet the conditions for being returned in their original condition – there must be no signs of wear on the soles or upper material, and they must be returned in their original box.
return.contactUs: Contact us by email or phone to request a return.
return.sendBack: Send the parcel back to us without cash on delivery. Return shipping costs are covered by the customer.
return.refundText: Once we receive the product and confirm that it is in perfect condition, we will refund the amount paid by bank transfer within 14 business days.
return.closing: If you have any additional questions or need help choosing the right size, our team is available for a personal consultation!
